question: What is the rank of India in the Global Hunger Index (GHI) 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**111**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Global Hunger Index (GHI)** is an important tool designed to measure and track hunger at global, regional, and national levels.
 
• In the **2023 Global Hunger Index**, India was ranked **111th** out of the countries assessed, which indicates a significant level of hunger in the nation.
 
• The index is calculated annually and is jointly published by **Concern Worldwide** and **Welthungerhilfe**.
